channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Em carta, Bolsonaro diz que Flávio é seu 'porta-voz' e pede pra deixar 'de lado diferenças', sem citar briga do filho com Michelle
item.description: In a letter read by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, former President Jair Bolsonaro designated him as his spokesperson and pre-candidate for the presidency, calling for unity and urging to set aside differences, without directly referencing the conflict with Michelle Bolsonaro. The letter comes after a public exchange of accusations between Flávio and Michelle on social media, which led to her resignation from the PL Women’s presidency. Bolsonaro is currently under house arrest following a conviction related to the alleged coup attempt after the 2022 election.

item.title: Bahamas Hotel Club, polêmica casa noturna, encerra atividades em São Paulo
item.description: The Bahamas Hotel Club, a São Paulo nightclub known for adult entertainment and legal controversies, has ceased operations after over 30 years. Founded by Oscar Maroni, dubbed the 'King of the Night,' the venue faced investigations for prostitution facilitation, human trafficking, and organized crime, while also hosting politically charged events, such as distributing beer in support of Lula and organizing Bolsonaro-aligned rallies. Maroni died in December 2025 at age 74 after being diagnosed with Alzheimer's, and the closure was confirmed on January 10, 2025, by Veja São Paulo.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio lê carta do ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) announced he will read live, at 12:30 PM this Saturday (Jul 11, 2026), a letter from his father, former president Jair Bolsonaro, on his YouTube channel. He said he visited his father that morning and that the ex-president is 'well' and 'strong'. Flávio described the document as a 'very important message' for the country, following his participation in the PL candidate launch in Ceará on Friday (Jul 10).

item.title: Edilson Capetinha revela torcida por Messi: "O cara se dedica"
item.description: Edilson Capetinha, the 2002 World Cup winner with Brazil, declared his support for Lionel Messi, praising the Argentine's dedication, competitive spirit, and emotional commitment on the field. He said Messi's level of effort is what he misses most in the Brazilian national team, contrasting it with the team's 'cold' performance in their elimination against Norway in the 2026 World Cup.

item.title: Eduardo chama Dino de “comunista totalitário” após operação contra Valdemar
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro defended PL party leader Valdemar Costa Neto after a Federal Police operation froze R$ 119 million in his assets, accusing Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino of being a 'totalitarian communist'. The operation is part of an investigation into alleged irregularities in parliamentary amendments. Eduardo's remarks reinforce the opposition's narrative of political persecution.

item.title: Piperno afirma que fãs de Neymar devem estar odiando Jorge Jesus
item.description: New Portugal coach Jorge Jesus revealed during his presentation that he had a frank conversation with Neymar during his time at Al-Hilal, telling him 'Tu, finish' (you're done). Journalist Piperno argues that this statement upset Neymar's fans in Brazil, particularly Flamengo supporters, who may now hate Jesus for speaking the truth in a culture of flattery surrounding the star.

item.title: Flávio e apoiadores gritam: “Lula ladrão, seu lugar é na prisão”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and his supporters shouted 'Lula thief, your place is in prison' during the PL's candidacy launch event in Fortaleza, marking the start of Alcides Fernandes' Senate pre-campaign. Flávio claimed criminals are more likely to vote for Lula than Bolsonaro, questioning PT supporters' choices. The incident occurred on July 10, 2026, with André Fernandes and his father Alcides Fernandes present on stage.

item.title: Ex-prefeito de Belford Roxo, Márcio Canella, preso pela PF durante Operação Unha e Carne, deve ser solto neste sábado
item.description: Former Belford Roxo mayor Márcio Canella, arrested by the PF in Operation Unha e Carne for illegal possession of a restricted-use rifle, is set to be released this Saturday following a decision by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. He will be required to wear an electronic ankle monitor and is running as a pre-candidate for the Senate under the União Brasil party with support from Flávio Bolsonaro. The investigation targets a money laundering scheme involving gas stations, with over R$ 7.6 billion in transactions over six years.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro defende Valdemar e chama Dino de 'comunista totalitário' indicado por Lula para 'perseguir adversários'
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro defended PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto after the Federal Police blocked R$119 million in his assets, calling Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino a 'totalitarian communist' appointed by Lula to persecute opponents. He denied receiving requests from Valdemar to direct amendment funds, stating such practices are standard across parties. Flávio Bolsonaro also backed Valdemar, accusing the PF of selective action against government opponents.

item.title: Moraes manda soltar ex-prefeito de Belford Roxo preso em operação da PF com fuzil no carro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered the release of Márcio Canella, former mayor of Belford Roxo and Senate pre-candidate for União Brasil, who was arrested with an AR-15-style .556 rifle in his car during Operation Unha e Carne. Canella’s defense stated the weapon was legally registered to his security detail, which supported the judge’s ruling. The PF investigation targets an alleged money-laundering scheme through gas stations, involving R$ 7.6 billion over six years.

item.title: Candidato do PL ao Senado impulsiona conteúdo negativo contra o PT, proibido por lei eleitoral
item.description: Filipe Barros (PL-PR), a pre-candidate for the Senate in Paraná, boosted negative content against the PT and President Lula on social media, a practice prohibited by Brazilian electoral law. The action is already being monitored by political opponents and may constitute economic abuse or improper use of communication channels. The exclusive subscriber-only article highlights the illegality of this premature campaign strategy.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se vacina contra o PT
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) performed a symbolic 'vaccination' against the PT during an event with allies in Ceará on Friday, the 10th. He used the phrase 'Bolsonaro vacinado' to reinforce his opposition to the party, noting that, unlike his father, he has adopted a more confrontational stance since the beginning of his pre-presidential campaign, still at the end of last year. The gesture was seen as a strategy to mobilize the Bolsonarist base against the Workers' Party.

item.title: A pesquisa e a reclamação de Lula contra o Supremo em ano eleitoral
item.description: President Lula reportedly complained to Supreme Court justices about the potential electoral damage caused by his association with Justices Alexandre de Moraes and Dias Toffoli, linked to the Banco Master investigation. He believes the justices’ tarnished image could hurt his 2026 re-election bid, despite publicly defending the Court. Lula also reiterated his longstanding resentment toward Toffoli, whom he appointed in 2009, claiming the justice denied him permission to attend his brother’s funeral while he was imprisoned in the Lava-Jato case.

item.title: Ayrton Senna passa a integrar o Livro dos Heróis e Heroínas da Pátria
item.description: Ayrton Senna was officially recognized as a National Hero following the signing of Law No. 15,447/2026 by President Lula, with his name inscribed in the Book of Heroes and Heroines of the Fatherland, housed in the Pantheon of the Fatherland in Brasília. The tribute, proposed by Senator Marcos Pontes in 2024 and approved by the Chamber’s Constitution and Justice Committee in March 2026, honors the legacy of the three-time Formula 1 World Champion, making him the 100th individual enshrined in the work. The Ayrton Senna Institute expressed gratitude, emphasizing the enduring impact of his legacy beyond the racetrack.

item.title: O incômodo de uma ala do PDT com as críticas de Kalil ao PT
item.description: A faction within the PDT expressed discomfort with Alexandre Kalil’s criticisms of the PT and President Lula, arguing he was aware of the national alliance between the PDT and Lula’s government before joining the party. Kalil, the pre-candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, ruled out a PT alliance in the first round and maintains an independent candidacy, despite having been seen as a potential beneficiary of PT support. The PDT plans to reinforce its alliance with Lula at a national convention in Brasília on July 20.

item.title: Moraes manda soltar ex-prefeito de Belford Roxo preso com fuzil no carro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered the release of former Belford Roxo mayor Márcio Canella (União Brasil), who was arrested with a .556 rifle in his vehicle during the 6th phase of Operation Unha e Carne. He will face charges while under liberty, subject to electronic monitoring, passport surrender, and suspension of firearms rights. The operation investigates money laundering through gas stations and alleged collusion between public officials and criminal factions.

item.title: A distância entre Lula e Flávio nas pesquisas eleitorais divulgadas nesta semana
item.description: The Meio/Ideia poll shows Lula leading Flávio Bolsonaro 45% to 40% in a potential runoff, maintaining a technical tie within the margin of error. In the first round, Lula leads with 40.4%, eight points ahead of Flávio at 32%, with 64% of voters already decided and Flávio’s rejection slightly rising. Despite recent political events, voting intentions for the two main candidates remained stable.

item.title: Apesar de Flávio, governo Lula acredita em capítulo final do tarifaço nos próximos dias
item.description: The Lula government believes the final outcome of the tariff hike will occur next Wednesday, with potential for more exceptions but no full rollback. The decision may be influenced by Donald Trump’s fear that the measure could harm the U.S. economy. A possible delay would be seen as a gesture to PL pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, who traveled to the U.S. to advocate against the measure to avoid benefiting Lula in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula destina 35,5% menos que Bolsonaro contra crimes na fronteira
item.description: Spending on Operation Ágata, coordinated by the Ministry of Defense, decreased by 35.5% in the first three years of Lula’s government compared to the same period under Bolsonaro, dropping from R$ 100.5 million to R$ 64.8 million. Despite the budget cut, the Ministry claims the 2025 operation inflicted over R$ 220 million in economic damage on criminal groups, and the 2026 edition has already exceeded R$ 1 billion in impact, focusing on illegal mining and drug trafficking in the triple border region between Brazil, Colombia, and Peru.

item.title: Verde, amarelo e azul são agora as cores do PT, que (quase) sumiu com o vermelho
item.description: PT candidates are adopting Brazil’s national team colors — green, yellow, and blue — in their campaigns, replacing the party’s traditional red with a more nationalist aesthetic less associated with the left. This trend is nationwide, seen in figures like Fernando Haddad in São Paulo, Jerônimo Rodrigues in Bahia, Elmano Freitas in Ceará, and Rafael Fontelles in Piauí, who wear sports jerseys or use blue tones in campaign materials. The PT’s red has nearly vanished, appearing only in exceptions such as Lula’s shirt or minor details.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro segura há um mês PL que asfixia lavagem de dinheiro no setor de combustíveis
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and president of the Senate Public Security Committee, has kept Bill 1482/2019 stalled in his drawer for one month. The bill aims to combat money laundering in the fuel sector but is being suffocated by lack of progress. The information was released in a subscriber-only exclusive report.

item.title: O jogo para 2026
item.description: Former president Michel Temer argues that strict adherence to the Constitution is key to pacifying Brazil and advancing structural reforms, criticizing distorted interpretations of provisions such as privileged forum, parliamentary immunity, and freedom of expression. He warns that deviating from the clear meaning of the Constitutional text turns the state into something that is no longer a rule-of-law state. While his proposals are seen as rational, the author questions whether there is real willingness to uphold the Constitution, suggesting that without it, no political project will succeed.

item.title: Líder supremo do Irã promete vingar assassinato do pai pelos EUA
item.description: Iran's Supreme Leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, pledged vengeance for the killing of his father, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, assassinated in a joint U.S.-Israeli attack in February 2026. The statement came after the father's burial in Mashhad, where crowds demanded revenge against U.S. President Donald Trump. The delayed funeral, held months after the death, occurred amid national polarization following anti-regime protests just seven months prior.

item.title: A indireta de André Fernandes a Michelle em ato com Flávio
item.description: During a political event with Flávio Bolsonaro, federal deputy André Fernandes (PL-CE) made an indirect remark toward former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro while formally launching his father Alcides Fernandes' (PL) Senate bid in Ceará. The event took place amid the race for the state's Senate seat.

item.title: Milei cruza a fronteira para inflar o palanque de Flávio
item.description: Journalist João Bosco Rabello argues that the announcement of Argentine President Javier Milei's visit to Brazil to support Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy constitutes direct foreign interference in Brazil's electoral campaign. He states that the physical presence of a foreign leader on a national campaign platform is a deliberate strategic move to bolster the '01' campaign, which is struggling amid internal opposition, and that any blockage of the meeting by Minister Alexandre de Moraes would be exploited by the right as a pretext to attack the Supreme Court and reinforce its persecution narrative.

item.title: Centro-direita e direita lideram corrida aos governos e expõem dificuldades para Lula
item.description: Lula supports Ceará Governor Elmano de Freitas for re-election, but polls show he may lose to Ciro Gomes, now a Bolsonaro ally. In 18 states, center-right and right-wing candidates lead gubernatorial polls, with the PL party fielding seven frontrunners, including Sergio Moro in Paraná. The PT struggles to grow in state races, with only six allied candidates leading — Rafael Fonteles of Piauí being the sole PT member.

item.title: Mesmo com corte de verbas, ANM diz apoiar governo em minerais críticos
item.description: The ANM expressed support for the federal government's critical minerals agenda, despite budget cuts that left the agency with only 4 workers in the area and operating at up to 60% of required staff. The letter sent to President Lula and Minister Alexandre Silveira affirms the regulator's willingness to collaborate with the Planalto's strategy to leverage Brazil's second-largest rare earth reserves. The agency warns that its weakened operational capacity contrasts with new responsibilities assigned by the Critical Minerals Bill and the 2050 National Mining Plan, which demand greater institutional capacity.

item.title: “Lula está cuidando do Flávio igual um peru de Natal”, diz Caiado
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) accused President Lula (PT) of 'taking care of' Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) like a Christmas turkey, implying that Lula is preserving the senator to face him in a potential 2026 runoff. Caiado claimed Lula is avoiding confrontation now to keep Flávio as a stronger opponent later.

item.title: Entenda o caso do “espião” russo expulso do Brasil
item.description: The Brazilian government expelled Sergey Vladimirovich Cherkasov, identified by the U.S. as a Russian military intelligence spy, for 30 years following his 2022 arrest for using false documents. He was investigated for espionage, money laundering, and corruption, and had attempted to gain access to the International Criminal Court under a false identity. Brazil rejected extradition requests from both Russia and the U.S., choosing expulsion as a sovereign decision.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva criticized Brazil's reliance on raw material exports and stated the country aims to become an exporter of intelligence and knowledge, particularly through the development of its rare earths. He suggested that if the U.S. is concerned about China, it should also pay attention to Brazil's technological and innovative potential.

item.title: Original Quem são os jogadores que vão liderar a Seleção na próxima Copa e tentar acabar com jejum do Brasil
item.description: Brazil’s national team is looking to bounce back from its early exit in the 2026 World Cup under a new cycle led by Carlo Ancelotti. Key players expected to lead the squad toward the 2030 World Cup include Vinicius Júnior, Rodrygo, Éder Militão and Estêvão, all with strong ties to Real Madrid and the potential to end Brazil’s historic title drought.

item.title: Lula acumula 19 declarações controversas e lapsos no 1º semestre de 2026
item.description: President Lula accumulated 19 controversial statements, gaffes, and lapses in the first half of 2026, including 8 deemed controversial, 6 containing factual errors, and 5 classified as offensive toward individuals, minority groups, or nationalities. His remarks in Santa Catarina on June 26 and 28 drew backlash from opponents, prompting the PL to file a complaint with the TSE alleging premature campaigning and hate speech, particularly for suggesting the state tolerates racism and white hegemony. Lula also referred to 'crazy black people' globally and criticized Donald Trump for seeking to seize Greenland, Canada, and the Panama Canal.

item.title: Tarcísio concentra campanha na capital em busca de vitória no 1º turno
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas is focusing his re-election campaign on São Paulo city and the metropolitan area to win in the first round, following strong performance in the interior in 2022. He prioritized inaugurations in the capital, including 200 apartments in Mooca, the Washington Luís metro station, a new police battalion, and the first section of Line 6-Orange. A Datafolha poll shows 46% voting intention for Tarcísio versus 30% for Haddad in the first round, with a larger lead in a potential runoff.

item.title: Jogos de hoje, sábado, 11 de julho: onde assistir futebol ao vivo e horários
item.description: On Saturday, July 11, 2026, three key matches are scheduled: Benfica vs Flamengo at 3:30 PM (international friendly), Norway vs England at 6:00 PM (2026 World Cup quarterfinal), and Argentina vs Switzerland at 10:00 PM (another World Cup quarterfinal). The games will be broadcast on Band, Sportv 2, ge tv, Premiere, and CazéTV. Although Neymar, Lula, and Cristiano are mentioned in the title regarding controversies, the content does not detail their involvement in the 2026 World Cup polemics, focusing solely on the match schedule.

item.title: PF: Assim como Valdemar, Eduardo Cunha destinou emendas sem ter mandato
item.description: The Federal Police identified a second case of lawmakers without a mandate directing amendments for personal interests, following suspicions about Valdemar da Costa Neto. Eduardo Cunha, despite losing his mandate, allegedly used amendments from federal deputies to benefit his own interests. The PF suspects this practice has spread throughout the Chamber of Deputies over the past eight years.

item.title: João Campos cola imagem a Lula, de futebol a vídeo de apoio, e campanha vê retomada de fôlego
item.description: João Campos (PSB)'s pre-campaign for governor of Pernambuco is strengthening its association with President Lula to regain momentum against incumbent Raquel Lyra (PSD). Allies report that after Lula's official support video and joint appearances — including watching a Brazil match and attending a hospital inauguration in Garanhuns — the association between Campos and Lula rose by over 10 percentage points, with Campos’ voting intention increasing by about 4 points. Internal polls and a Paraná Pesquisas survey show a technical tie, with Campos leading in some local surveys for the first time.

item.title: Deputados turbinam gastos de cota parlamentar com publicidade no Instagram e Facebook
item.description: Brazilian federal deputies spent R$ 2.1 million from their parliamentary allowances to boost political ads on Instagram and Facebook between January and June 2026, nearly four times the amount spent in the same period of 2022. Deputy Bruno Ganem (Podemos-SP) was the top individual spender, allocating R$ 155,000 to promote a video on animal welfare amendments, reaching over 1 million people in São Paulo. The surge reflects Meta’s dominance in political advertising after Google and other platforms banned such ads in 2024, leaving Meta as the sole viable option for boosting content.

item.title: Investigação contra Valdemar gera desgaste na pré-campanha de Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign faces new strain as Federal Police investigate PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto for allegedly diverting parliamentary amendments and participating in a criminal scheme involving R$ 119 million. The operation also targeted Márcio Canella, Flávio's Senate ally in Belford Roxo, intensifying pressure on the PL ticket. Flávio defended Valdemar, claiming the PF is acting selectively.

item.title: Imparáveis: o que é o novo movimento coordenado por Michelle Bolsonaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro launched the 'Imparáveis' movement after stepping down as head of PL Mulher, aiming to sustain the female mobilization of the Liberal Party amid family conflict with Flávio Bolsonaro. Though originating within the PL, the movement claims no partisan affiliation and seeks to continue her ideals of female inclusion in politics, with over 72,000 women having joined the party under her leadership.

item.title: Valdemar Costa Neto recebe o troco de Flávio nas entrelinhas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro avoided directly defending Valdemar Costa Neto amid a PF operation that blocked up to R$ 119 million in assets tied to alleged parliamentary amendment fraud, instead stating the leader 'will know how to give all answers' — a direct echo of the slight Valdemar inflicted on him in the Vorcaro audio leak. The analysis suggests the senator used the incident to reinforce his narrative of police persecution, leaving the PL boss isolated and exposed, with the Bolsonaro clan’s protective shield fractured and friendly fire spiraling out of control.

item.title: Corrida pela vaga: mesmo em recesso, Alerj se mobiliza para escolher quem vai ocupar lugar de Domingos Brazão no TCE-RJ
item.description: The Rio de Janeiro State Legislature (Alerj) is mobilizing during parliamentary recess to select a replacement for Domingos Brazão at the TCE-RJ following his definitive conviction by the STF to 76 years in prison for the murders of Marielle Franco and Anderson Gomes. The lifetime position, paying around R$ 40,000 with compulsory retirement at 75, is being formalized by the TCE, which will notify Alerj to schedule a vote, possibly in July. Lawmakers fear the selection will be disrupted by the proximity of the 2026 elections and potential new PF investigations, making internal consensus difficult despite the governing coalition’s majority.

item.title: Projeto “Imparáveis” de Michelle Bolsonaro tem lançamento antecipado após racha com Flávio
item.description: The 'Imparáveis' project, created by Michelle Bolsonaro and her team for social media, was launched eight months ahead of schedule following a rift with Flávio Bolsonaro. The initiative aims to strengthen the Bolsonaro family's digital presence ahead of the 2026 elections. Full access to the article requires a subscriber login.

item.title: Disputa polarizada à Presidência provoca desistências e dificulta planos de pré-candidatos
item.description: The polarized presidential race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro is leading to withdrawals by pre-candidates, including Aécio Neves (PSDB) and potentially Joaquim Barbosa (DC), as others struggle to gain traction in a two-dominant-field scenario. The DC admits Barbosa may drop out, given his negligible polling (1%), with the August 5 convention deadline approaching.

item.title: Com viagem marcada para o Brasil, Milei quer visitar Bolsonaro na prisão domiciliar; entenda se a lei permite
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei announced he will visit Brazil on July 25 to attend the ceremony formalizing Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential pre-candidacy and intends to greet former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest in Brasília. The meeting requires approval from the Supreme Federal Court (STF), as visits to Bolsonaro are limited to family, lawyers, and health staff under an order by Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Entrevista: 'Master é abalo sísmico para o STF. Quem julga o julgador?', diz o jurista Joaquim Falcão
item.description: Jurist Joaquim Falcão denounces a 'conspiracy' among the branches of government, claiming the Supreme Court, Congress, and Executive benefit mutually by avoiding effective checks, as seen in the Master case. He argues this 'selective harmony' undermines democracy by limiting freedom and equality, and advocates for term limits for Supreme Court justices as a check on absolute power.

item.title: Haaland virou nome de centenas de bebês no Peru
item.description: The name of Norwegian striker Erling Haaland became popular for newborns in Peru after the 2026 World Cup, with at least 593 babies registered in his honor, especially following Norway's victory over Brazil. Despite the rise in Haaland-inspired names, Neymar (33,000) and Endrick (3,332) remain far more common in Peru. The article also notes Peru's poor performance in the 2026 qualifiers and Brazil's historically weak campaign in the tournament, which matched its worst World Cup showing.

item.title: Os redutos de Lula e Bolsonaro em MG; veja onde cada um liderou
item.description: In Minas Gerais, Lula led in the North and the Jequitinhonha and Mucuri valleys, while Bolsonaro won in eight of the state's ten largest electoral colleges, concentrating strength in the South. The 2022 race was decided by just 40,650 votes, highlighting the state's electoral balance. This divided geography between interior and major urban centers explains the intense fight for a presidential ticket in Minas for 2026.

item.title: Flávio diz que governo Lula usa PF para "perseguir oposição"
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro accused the Lula government of using the Federal Police to persecute the opposition and interfere in the 2026 elections, citing cases involving President Lula’s relatives, such as Lulinha and José Ferreira da Silva, and claiming the PF acts selectively while neglecting investigations into government allies.

item.title: China pode elevar tarifa da carne brasileira a 67%, diz Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) accused the Lula government of failing in negotiations with China, which could result in a 67% tariff on Brazilian beef exports exceeding the annual quota of 1.1 million tons set for 2026. He also criticized the government’s handling of talks with the European Union, claiming that Brazil’s failure to meet antimicrobial use requirements in animal production led to its removal from the list of authorized exporters to the bloc.

item.title: Flávio diz que facções tornaram comunidade um “bairro fantasma” no CE
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro visited the Vila Velha community in Fortaleza (CE) and denounced criminal factions controlling the area, describing it as a "ghost neighborhood" due to resident displacement. He criticized state inaction and called for a bolder approach to combat crime, aligning with the PL’s public security narrative. The senator also attended a PL event in Ceará launching Alcides Fernandes’ Senate pre-candidacy, part of the party’s 2026 electoral strategy.
